text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ooooh!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Almond Eye!! She's unstoppable!
Just how many victories will this Umamusume rack up?!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"How far?
To the ends of the earth, of course...!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Yes! We did it, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Snap!)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm so sorry...!
Are you okay...!?
choice_data_list: I'm fine! Happiness is winning out anyway...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha...! 
Well then, no problem at all!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ……Aaaaargh!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I've made up my mind!!
I will... definitely race against Ai-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Just you wait, Ai-senpaaai!
—In the mile!!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ai-chaaangh, you're way too incredibleee!!
You definitely gotta win the next one too--!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
That was another magnificent victory!
Congratulations...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much!
First of all, I'm just so happy that I won!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"That's true! Which means the race on everyone's minds now is—
the next target race that Ai-san is going to 'win'...?!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Here...
Trainer, this is for you!
choice_data_list: ...First, let's recover from the fatigue of back-to-back races.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Yes! With the training camp coming up, looks like I'll spend the summer focusing on self-care.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: “However, I don't intend to take things so leisurely. ……Right?”
choice_data_list: Yeah. Our next goal is the Tenno Sho (Autumn)
Yeah. The next goal is the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: (Oooooooh...!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A crucial GⅠ race of the autumn...
A stage rich in tradition and prestige is truly worthy of your next victory.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...So that's the race that moves your heart.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
And so, next is the Tenno Sho (Autumn)—
and I will win it!
